package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	OnboardingPathExecutionSchema = "planner-onboarding-path-execution.v1"
	OnboardingPathOutcomeSchema   = "planner-onboarding-path-outcome.v1"
	SubjectOnboardingPathOutcome  = "planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1"

	OnboardingExecutionPending          = "PENDING"
	OnboardingExecutionSnapshotFrozen   = "SNAPSHOT_FROZEN"
	OnboardingExecutionCourseFrozen     = "COURSE_FROZEN"
	OnboardingExecutionPathReady        = "PATH_READY"
	OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists = "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS"
	OnboardingExecutionStateChanged     = "STATE_CHANGED"
	OnboardingExecutionFailed           = "FAILED"
)

// OnboardingPathExecution is a separate S9 aggregate.  The S8 handoff remains
// immutable historical admission evidence and is never updated into a job.
type OnboardingPathExecution struct {
	ExecutionID         string
	Handoff             OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord
	Status              string
	RequestHash         string
	Snapshot            json.RawMessage
	SnapshotHash        string
	GeneratedCourse     json.RawMessage
	GeneratedCourseHash string
	CourseID            string
	CourseReused        bool
	CourseLessons       []CourseLessonBinding
	AdmissionID         string
	AdmissionFence      int64
	AdmissionExpiresAt  *time.Time
	ReserveKey          string
	StudentCommandID    string
	StudentCommandHash  string
	LearningPathID      string
	FirstLessonID       string
	Attempts            int
	ClaimToken          string
	LeaseUntil          *time.Time
	NextAttemptAt       time.Time
	FailureCode         string
	CreatedAt           time.Time
	UpdatedAt           time.Time
	CompletedAt         *time.Time
}

// OnboardingPathLessonContent is immutable per-lesson AI evidence.  It is
// deliberately separate from the assembled Course checkpoint so a process
// crash never repeats a successfully parsed confidential prompt response.
type OnboardingPathLessonContent struct {
	ExecutionID      string
	LessonIndex      int
	ModuleCode       string
	SectionCode      string
	LessonCode       string
	AIIdempotencyKey string
	Content          json.RawMessage
	ContentHash      string
	CreatedAt        time.Time
}

func NewOnboardingPathExecution(handoff OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, now time.Time) (OnboardingPathExecution, error) {
	handoff, err := NormalizeOnboardingPlanHandoffRecord(handoff)
	if err != nil {
		return OnboardingPathExecution{}, err
	}
	// UUID v5 provides a stable aggregate identity across discovery/replay races.
	id := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("planner-onboarding-path-execution:"+handoff.HandoffID)).String()
	studentCommand := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("student-onboarding-path-materialize:"+id)).String()
	reserveKey := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("student-onboarding-path-reserve:"+id)).String()
	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join([]string{handoff.HandoffID, handoff.StudentID, handoff.Goal.Code, handoff.Goal.Version, handoff.Goal.GraphVersion}, "\x00")))
	return OnboardingPathExecution{ExecutionID: id, Handoff: handoff, Status: OnboardingExecutionPending,
		RequestHash: hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), StudentCommandID: studentCommand, ReserveKey: reserveKey,
		NextAttemptAt: now.UTC(), CreatedAt: now.UTC(), UpdatedAt: now.UTC()}, nil
}

// OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey is a deterministic, distinct Student
// idempotency key.  The operation name and current fence are part of the
// identity so Student's global operation inbox never treats reserve, renew,
// materialize, and abort as one command.
func OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey(executionID, operation string, fence int64) string {
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("student-onboarding-path:"+executionID+":"+operation+":"+strconv.FormatInt(fence, 10))).String()
}

func IsOnboardingExecutionTerminal(status string) bool {
	switch status {
	case OnboardingExecutionPathReady, OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists, OnboardingExecutionStateChanged, OnboardingExecutionFailed:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

type OnboardingPathOutcome struct {
	Schema         string `json:"schema"`
	ExecutionID    string `json:"execution_id"`
	HandoffID      string `json:"handoff_id"`
	StudentID      string `json:"student_id"`
	DialogID       string `json:"dialog_id"`
	TeacherJobID   string `json:"teacher_job_id"`
	Status         string `json:"status"`
	CourseID       string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	FirstLessonID  string `json:"first_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	FailureCode    string `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
}

func NewOnboardingPathOutcome(execution OnboardingPathExecution) (OnboardingPathOutcome, error) {
	if !IsOnboardingExecutionTerminal(execution.Status) || execution.Status == OnboardingExecutionFailed {
		return OnboardingPathOutcome{}, ErrValidation
	}
	out := OnboardingPathOutcome{Schema: OnboardingPathOutcomeSchema, ExecutionID: execution.ExecutionID,
		HandoffID: execution.Handoff.HandoffID, StudentID: execution.Handoff.StudentID, DialogID: execution.Handoff.DialogID,
		TeacherJobID: execution.Handoff.TeacherJobID, Status: execution.Status}
	if execution.Status == OnboardingExecutionPathReady {
		if execution.CourseID == "" || execution.LearningPathID == "" || execution.FirstLessonID == "" {
			return OnboardingPathOutcome{}, ErrValidation
		}
		out.CourseID, out.LearningPathID, out.FirstLessonID = execution.CourseID, execution.LearningPathID, execution.FirstLessonID
	} else if execution.CourseID != "" || execution.LearningPathID != "" || execution.FirstLessonID != "" {
		return OnboardingPathOutcome{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return out, nil
}
